### 🏆 Rewards Program
- Domino's Rewards members can redeem points for free items at different tiers — **20 points** gets you appetizers, sides, or desserts after just two orders, while **60 points** scores you a free medium 2-topping pizza.
- There's also **Emergency Pizza** — if you place a qualifying delivery order and something goes wrong, you can claim a free medium two-topping pizza within seven days.

---

### 💡 Tips to Save More
- Signing up for Domino's **email and text alerts** gets you access to limited-time offers and location-specific deals. These alerts often include current coupon codes and flash sales.
- The **app and website also price differently** on the same order — app-only deals usually beat anything offered through the desktop site, so the cheapest route is to start in the app and check the local Deals tab.
- Only **one coupon can be applied per order**, so choose the best deal available, and check the "Coupons" section on the Domino's website or app for location-specific offers.
- Following **Domino's on social media** is one of the easiest ways to catch promo codes, flash deals, and even free food offers that don't always make it to their website.
